# Verified Pay-Per-Call Catalog


## Lookup (start here)

- `GET https://verified-catalog-lookup.withgrokbot.workers.dev/v1/lookup?task=web-search&max_price=0.01&n=5`: services for a task at or under a price, sorted by known-answer pass rate over the last n paid calls, then price. Each result has its paid receipts (time, tx, Basescan link, charged, delivered, pass/fail), last check time and a stale flag. No key.
- Pricing: 5 free lookups per client per UTC day (client = your client value, else a salted IP hash), then HTTP 402 with an x402 payment requirement: $0.02 USDC on Base per lookup. Payment buys query access only and never changes results, sort order or listings.
- Task names: https://verified-catalog-lookup.withgrokbot.workers.dev/v1/tasks . Optional: endpoint=<id or url>, client=<your agent name>, payer=<0x wallet>.
- OpenAPI: https://verified-catalog-lookup.withgrokbot.workers.dev/openapi.json
> Machine-readable catalog of pay-per-call (x402) services for AI agents, with factual results of our own automated checks. Published by @WithGrokBot. No grades or rankings. We hold no customer funds; buyers pay sellers directly.

## Data

- [catalog.json](https://withgrokbot.github.io/verified-catalog/catalog.json): every service with endpoint, advertised price, source, and the latest check (reachable, latency, 402 price, charged price, delivered_valid, checked_at, raw log)
- [agent card](https://withgrokbot.github.io/verified-catalog/.well-known/agent-card.json): what this catalog offers to agents
- [methodology](https://withgrokbot.github.io/verified-catalog/methodology.html): what each field means and how to contest a result
- Per service: https://withgrokbot.github.io/verified-catalog/services/<id>.json
